answer.rationale: At 94% committed line volume, a primary-vendor migration in the 14-day window creates material delivery and qualification risk. First pursue an expedited incumbent renewal negotiation targeting the full 18% spend reduction, using market benchmarking and a longer-volume commitment if the archived records confirm those levers achieved sufficient savings without service-scope erosion. If the incumbent cannot meet the mandated reduction, the low-cost switch remains the next-review decision rather than an assumed risk-free move.
